name: The Returns Desk: A Cozy Library

reviews.review_title: Is it weird I love this game?
reviews.review_description:
I was pretty excited for this game to come out. I have to look through newest games to see EVERYTHING that's coming out since i own every good game & not so good game on quest. Quest doesn't advertise half the games that are coming out unless they're by some popular company. Anyway, I thought this looked really cool. Kinda like being a librarian without having to deal with people. I have a little touch of OCD so categorizing and shelving stuff is pretty fun. Their comfort settings are true. You can sit, stand, snap turn or smooth turn. I'm big on sitting and smooth turn since I have rheumatoid arthritis. 
Anyway, I played for 2 hours yesterday...I finished 3 wings and bought some collection items and upgrades (for points, not real money). There is still TONS more sections. I'm about to play more now. 
Awesome game! A game doesn't have to be brutal and exciting to be enjoyable.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for review.

I’m especially glad the comfort settings work for you. Sitting with smooth turning is how a lot of people play, and I want everyone to be able to stay in the library as long as they like

Three wings down means you have plenty of shelves left. Enjoy the rest of them, and thanks again for the kind words and for taking the time to write them.

Lamplit
